title: Return Authorization Conditions — Returns & Exchanges Policy
content:
A Returns & Exchanges return is authorized only when every condition below is met. The conditions read the order and the customer's holdings as the system records show them; what the customer says about a date or a holding does not replace the record.

## 1. Order status

A return is authorized only for an order in status delivered or closed. A parcel that is not yet delivered, or that the customer says never arrived, is handled as a Delivery Claims case, not as a return. The status checked is the status of the order the return is opened against.

## 2. Return window

A return is authorized only if it is requested no later than the return window in calendar days after the order is delivered.

- **Length.** The window is the return type's window for non-footwear lines, or its footwear window for footwear lines, plus the returning customer's Marlowe Rewards return window extension days where the return type adds them, the tier being the one held on the request date.
- **Holiday deliveries.** Where the return type takes the holiday extension, an order delivered from the first through the last day of the holiday delivery period instead has the later of the result above and the holiday return-by date of the following year.
- **Counting.** Window days are counted as calendar days after the delivered date, the delivered date being day zero, and the last day of the window still qualifies. The clock starts from the order's delivered date as recorded on the order.

| Request date | Result |
|---|---|
| On or before the window's last day | Within the window |
| On the window's last day | Within the window (the last day qualifies) |
| The day after the window's last day | Outside the window |

## 3. Return-by date

The return-by date of an authorization is the earlier of the window's last day and the authorization date plus the label validity days of the return type. Whether the parcel went back in time is proven by its first carrier scan.

## 4. Who may request

The requester must be the customer who placed the order, except on a Gift Return, where the order must be flagged as a gift and the requester is a different customer who quotes its order number. The purchaser and the gift flag are read from the order record; the order number is the one the requester quotes.

## 5. Items and method

Never returnable on this path: gift-card lines, final-sale lines, personalised items, and swimwear or intimates without the hygiene liner and tags, each as the return type sets it. A Quality Issue Return lifts the final-sale and personalisation limits. Partial quantities of a line are allowed. The return method must be one of the methods the return type offers.

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

- Delivered 3 March, 30-day window, no Marlowe Rewards extension: day zero is 3 March and the last day is 2 April. A request on 2 April qualifies; a request on 3 April does not.
- The same order for a customer whose tier carries a 15-day extension (hypothetical figure), on a type that adds it: the last day becomes 17 April.
- Delivered 10 December on a type with the holiday extension and a 30-day window: the window alone ends 9 January; the later of that and 31 January is 31 January, so a request on 31 January qualifies.
- Delivered 26 December: outside the holiday delivery period, so a 30-day window ends 25 January.
- Authorized on 25 March with a window ending 2 April and 30 label validity days: the authorization date plus 30 days is 24 April, so the return-by date is the earlier date, 2 April.
- Authorized on 15 December with a window ending 31 January and 30 label validity days: the return-by date is 14 January, the earlier of the two.
